Interruptions under 5 minutes keep a day green and are marked with a thin line. Select a day to see its incidents. All times UTC.

Checks run every 30 seconds from our monitoring service. Uptime excludes observed outages; degraded performance is tracked separately. A day turns amber after 5 minutes of downtime and red after an hour; shorter interruptions are still listed in the incident log. Earlier restarts come from retained service logs and don’t imply continuous monitoring. Local AI is monitored independently from the moderation bot.
